property: Two separate mail-destination/mail-forwarder RR types are replaced by one MX RR type carrying a preference value and exchanger host, simplifying complete ordered-set caching and mailer routing behavior.

date_or_range.notes: RFC 1035 marks MD and MF obsolete and explicitly explains the redesigned single-MX-type approach.

sources.locator: DOMAIN SUPPORT FOR MAIL and RR type definitions

sources.supports: MD/MF obsolete; use MX; rationale for single ordered type

negative_claims: This does not imply DNS replaced every non-DNS mail-routing mechanism immediately.
MX is not SMTP; it provides routing/location data used by mailers.
open_questions: Recover the intermediate RFC 973/early MX design documents and first deployed MX-aware mailers.
notes: A strong example of distributed-cache semantics driving a protocol data-model redesign.
